# Postal places - English (US): a city, its state and up to ten of its ZIP codes on each line,
# separated by tabs, with the ZIP codes separated by commas. The state is named as in
# krandom/states/en_US_states.txt.
#
# Places:    every city of krandom/cities/en_US_cities.txt, taken as the most populous incorporated
#            place of that name in the Census Bureau's Vintage 2024 population estimates, so
#            Springfield is Springfield, Missouri. Each state, and the District of Columbia, that none
#            of them is in adds its most populous place: Wilmington (Delaware), Portland (Maine),
#            Burlington (Vermont), Charleston (West Virginia) and Cheyenne (Wyoming). 252 places in all,
#            in all 50 states and DC. A place keeps the city's usual name where the Census Bureau names
#            it for a consolidated government or otherwise: Athens-Clarke County, Augusta-Richmond
#            County, Indianapolis city (balance), Lexington-Fayette, Louisville/Jefferson County,
#            Nashville-Davidson, Urban Honolulu CDP, Boise City and San Buenaventura (Ventura).
# ZIP codes: the ZIP Code Tabulation Areas (ZCTAs) with more than half of their land area inside the
#            place, in the 2020 ZCTA to place relationship file. A ZCTA is the Census Bureau's area for
#            a USPS ZIP code and carries its five digits. Cheyenne, Escondido and Santa Maria have no
#            such ZCTA and take the one with the most land inside them. A place with more than ten
#            keeps ten, spread evenly through them in numeric order.
# Checked:   every ZCTA is in the place's state: the county that holds most of its land, in the 2020
#            ZCTA to county relationship file, is in that state.
#
# Source:    U.S. Census Bureau
#            - 2024 Gazetteer Files, places (the state of each place code):
#              https://www2.census.gov/geo/docs/maps-data/data/gazetteer/2024_Gazetteer/2024_Gaz_place_national.zip
#              SHA-256 cf262fc92b2326f7a8c62a89d156a60eb17d64d6d35f7a62310c43bb08972c06
#            - City and Town Population Totals: 2020-2024 (Vintage 2024):
#              https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/popest/datasets/2020-2024/cities/totals/sub-est2024.csv
#              SHA-256 af9cd4835c93552a2161fc88bf4d7aa31e81b4f16f7457980b95295cf91e49e9
#            - 2020 ZCTA to place relationship file:
#              https://www2.census.gov/geo/docs/maps-data/data/rel2020/zcta520/tab20_zcta520_place20_natl.txt
#              SHA-256 698a5dad71ed419411677d0ffd8ecd9331067f59c472cdd239b92c12f698285d
#            - 2020 ZCTA to county relationship file:
#              https://www2.census.gov/geo/docs/maps-data/data/rel2020/zcta520/tab20_zcta520_county20_natl.txt
